mt5.description: Basic Attention Token vs US Dollar

narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -14.41 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.07489-0.07491 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.07637; the first objective pays 1.35R at 0.07430.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.07637 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.35 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 27/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below
